search_exa: search the Exa AI API for a query and return structured SearchResult objects
create_exa_result_model: create a pydantic ExaResult dataclass with url, title, and text fields
filter_exa_search_domains: filter Exa search results by a list of allowed domains using includeDomains
extract_exa_text_highlights: extract text and highlights from Exa search results for rich snippets
handle_exa_api_errors: handle Exa API errors gracefully and return an empty result list on failure
